name: KiWay Fanout Generator
description: Preview and generate advanced SMD, BGA, and LGA fanouts with persistent grouped commits.
description_full: Creates reviewable dogbone, quadrant, four-corner, perimeter, radial, grid, and via-in-pad fanouts. Scope work to selected pads, selected footprints, reference wildcards, or all SMD pads; preview actual footprint extents, pad locations, tracks, and scaled vias in the window and on the PCB before committing a native KiCad group.
